title: Credit and Collections Manual: Late Payment Charge Forgiveness When an Electric Service Agreement Balance Is Transferred
content:
## Section rule

The late payment charges already posted on a closed **Electric Service Agreement** are forgiven at transfer according to how long the closed agreement was in service, counted in whole calendar months from its start date to its stop date:

- **48 whole calendar months or more** — forgiven in full (a share of 1, that is 100% of the posted late payment charges);
- **at least 24 but fewer than 48 months** — forgiven by half (a share of 0.5);
- **fewer than 24 months** — not forgiven at all.

The posted late payment charges are every late payment charge recorded on the closed agreement, whatever its date.

## Effect on the transfer amount

The forgiven late payment charges are the posted late payment charges multiplied by the share above. They are subtracted from the closed agreement's balance before the transfer amount is rounded to the cent; the forgiven figure is not rounded on its own.

## Tenure boundaries (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical start date | Hypothetical stop date | Whole months in service | Share forgiven |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May 2020 | 10 May 2024 | 48 | in full |
| 10 May 2020 | 9 May 2024 | 47 | half |
| 10 May 2020 | 10 May 2022 | 24 | half |
| 10 May 2020 | 9 May 2022 | 23 | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical inputs)

Late payment charges of USD 9.40 posted on the closed agreement: forgiven USD 9.40 at 48 months or more, USD 4.70 at 24 to 47 months, USD 0.00 below 24 months.
